heading: Travis Kelce's latest NFL record says plenty about what made the Chiefs star so difficult to bring down after catches
author: Global Sports Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM /  Sep 21, 2026, 08:10 IST
paragraphs: Travis Kelce added another unusual entry to his NFL résumé on Sunday, moving past Marshall Faulk to become the league’s all-time leader in career yards after the catch
The Kansas City Chiefs tight end reached the mark during the team’s matchup with the Indianapolis Colts, giving fresh weight to one of the most recognizable parts of his game
Kelce has never needed to rely only on speed to create extra yards
His balance, strength and feel for space have repeatedly allowed him to turn ordinary completions into bigger gains
That skill now has a record attached to it.How did Travis Kelce become the NFL’s all-time YAC leader?The record is a useful way to understand why Kelce has been such a difficult matchup for defenders

Yards after the catch measure what happens once a receiver secures the ball, and Kelce has spent much of his career making that part of the play count.In 2024, the Chiefs noted that Kelce had already moved into fourth place all time in career yards after the catch, with 5,632 yards at that point

Kelce’s ability to close that gap is striking because Faulk was a running back known for his receiving work, not a tight end operating in the middle of an NFL passing game.Kelce has often made the first defender miss or simply powered through contact
He can catch a short pass, turn upfield and keep moving instead of settling for the yardage created by the throw
That has been a major part of his value to Patrick Mahomes and Kansas City over the years.The milestone also adds another layer to a career already filled with receiving records

Kelce has consistently produced from different areas of the field, whether lined up tight to the formation, in the slot or outside.What made Travis Kelce’s latest milestone stand out?The timing gave the record an extra bit of attention
Kelce also scored his first touchdown of the 2026 season against Indianapolis, giving the Chiefs star a productive night beyond the statistical milestone

Sports Illustrated reported that Taylor Swift celebrated from a suite, pointing to her wedding ring and shouting, “That’s my husband!”The moment quickly spread online, but Kelce’s record is the more lasting part of the night
It reflects a skill that can be easy to overlook because it happens after the catch rather than at the point of it.There is also something revealing about the name Kelce passed
Faulk was one of the NFL’s most versatile offensive players, so taking the top spot from him highlights how unusual Kelce’s career has been

A tight end leading the league in a category heavily shaped by running backs and receivers is not a routine achievement.For Kansas City, it is another statistical marker tied directly to what Kelce has done best
He catches the ball, stays on his feet and keeps the play alive
Now, that part of his game sits alone at the top of the NFL record book.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates
